content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, information, or medical-necessity issue; the claim’s codes, eligibility, and COB are already valid. Resubmitting without identifying a coding or bundling correction risks another denial, while the available appeal action has the wrong basis. A specialist must review the paid companion service and payer bundling rules to determine whether a modifier or coding appeal is supportable."}
